title: Reconcile invocation slot retirement with native abandonment and unproven placeholder saturation
outcome: Explicit producer-native abandonment releases only the original invocation slots it proves ended; unproven placeholder capacity has an accurately scoped loss policy. Unfinished processes, NotFinished, host turns and artifact Unknown do not become completion proof.
acceptance: Reconcile invocation slot retirement with native abandonment and unproven placeholder saturation is done
